__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus (HVM host exporters)
__inputs.description: Prometheus that scrapes node_exporter and prometheus-libvirt-exporter on the HVM hosts

title: HVM Hosts and VMs
description: HVM host and VM usage from node_exporter and prometheus-libvirt-exporter

list.name: source
list.label: Environment
list.description: Value of the 'source' label on the HVM host scrape jobs

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: One row per HVM host. Load / core is the 5 minute load average divided by the number of logical CPUs; values that stay above 1 mean more runnable work than CPUs.

targets.expr: max by (nodename) (100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", source="$source", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (nodename) (100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (nodename) ((node_load5{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"} / on (instance) count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", source="$source", instance=~"$instance"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (nodename) ((count by (instance) (libvirt_domain_info_state{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"} == 1) or on (instance) 0 * count by (instance) (node_uname_info{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})
max by (nodename) ((count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", source="$source", instance=~"$instance"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})
max by (nodename) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})
max by (nodename) ((time() - node_boot_time_seconds{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

panels.title: Host CPU %
panels.description: Share of host CPU time not idle, averaged over all logical CPUs.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", source="$source", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

panels.title: Host memory used %
panels.description: 100 - MemAvailable / MemTotal. Available memory includes reclaimable page cache.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

panels.title: Host disk IOPS
panels.description: Completed reads and writes per second on physical disks (device-mapper, md and optical devices excluded).

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

panels.title: Host disk latency
panels.description: Average time per completed read and write request.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

(sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"dm-.*|sr.*|md.*|loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

panels.title: Host network
panels.description: Bytes per second per network interface. A VLAN interface and its bond both count the same traffic.

targets.expr: rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"lo|vnet.*|veth.*|tap.*|virbr.*|docker.*|br-.*|ovs.*|genev_sys.*|vxlan.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", device!~"lo|vnet.*|veth.*|tap.*|virbr.*|docker.*|br-.*|ovs.*|genev_sys.*|vxlan.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"}

panels.title: Virtual machines
panels.description: One row per libvirt domain. CPU % is CPU time used divided by the number of vCPUs. vCPU wait % is the time the vCPUs were ready to run but waited for a physical CPU. Host RSS is the memory the VM process holds on the host.

targets.expr: max by (domain, nodename) ((libvirt_domain_info_state{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})
max by (domain, nodename) ((libvirt_domain_info_virtual_cpus{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (domain, nodename) ((100 * sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) / on (instance, domain) libvirt_domain_info_virtual_cpus{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (domain, nodename) ((100 * sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) / on (instance, domain) libvirt_domain_info_virtual_cpus{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (domain, nodename) ((libvirt_domain_info_maximum_memory_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})
max by (domain, nodename) ((libvirt_domain_memory_stats_rss_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (domain, nodename) ((sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (domain, nodename) ((sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (domain, nodename) ((sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

max by (domain, nodename) ((sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by CPU %
panels.description: CPU time used divided by the number of vCPUs of the VM.

targets.expr: topk(10, (100 * sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)))) / on (instance, domain) libvirt_domain_info_virtual_cpus{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by host memory (RSS)
panels.description: Memory the VM process holds on the host.

targets.expr: topk(10, (libvirt_domain_memory_stats_rss_bytes{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by write IOPS
panels.description: Write requests per second, all disks of the VM.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by network receive
panels.description: Bytes received per second, all interfaces of the VM.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (instance, domain) ((rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) unless (resets(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 or (min_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) == 0 and max_over_time(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{source="$source", instance=~"$instance", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{source="$source"})
